# Datos de Garmin Connect

Rango: 2024-02-17 → 2024-02-21 (5 días)
Exportado: 2026-10-15 20:53 (America/Guatemala)

Cada archivo es un CSV con encabezado. Fechas locales en formato YYYY-MM-DD. Nombres de columnas tal como los entrega Garmin; la unidad va entre paréntesis.

## Archivos (21)
- `activities.csv`: Todas las actividades: tipo, duración, distancia, FC, calorías. 4 filas, 2023-11-29 → 2024-02-14.
  Columnas: activityId, activityName, startTimeLocal, distance (m), duration (s), movingDuration (s), elapsedDuration (s), averageSpeed (m/s), calories (kcal), averageHR (bpm), maxHR (bpm), steps, aerobicTrainingEffect, anaerobicTrainingEffect, activityTrainingLoad, trainingEffectLabel, moderateIntensityMinutes, vigorousIntensityMinutes, differenceBodyBattery, lapCount, hrTimeInZone_1 (s), hrTimeInZone_2 (s), hrTimeInZone_3 (s), hrTimeInZone_4 (s), hrTimeInZone_5 (s), minTemperature, maxTemperature, avgElevation, elevationGain, elevationLoss, totalReps, totalSets, activeSets, aerobicTrainingEffectMessage, anaerobicTrainingEffectMessage, vO2MaxValue, avgStrideLength, locationName, startLatitude, startLongitude, endLatitude, endLongitude, averageRunningCadenceInStepsPerMinute, maxRunningCadenceInStepsPerMinute, activityType
- `body_battery.csv`: Body Battery: carga, descarga y nivel por día. 5 filas, 2024-02-17 → 2024-02-21.
  Columnas: date, charged, drained, startTimestampLocal, endTimestampLocal
- `caminar.csv`: Caminatas, una fila por actividad. 1 filas, 2024-02-12 → 2024-02-12.
  Columnas: activityId, activityName, startTimeLocal, distance (m), duration (s), movingDuration (s), calories (kcal), averageHR (bpm), maxHR (bpm), steps, aerobicTrainingEffect, anaerobicTrainingEffect, activityTrainingLoad, trainingEffectLabel, differenceBodyBattery, hrTimeInZone_1 (s), hrTimeInZone_2 (s), hrTimeInZone_3 (s), hrTimeInZone_4 (s), hrTimeInZone_5 (s), moderateIntensityMinutes, vigorousIntensityMinutes, avgElevation, minTemperature, maxTemperature, totalReps, totalSets, activeSets, lapCount, averageSpeed (m/s), activityType
- `caminar_laps.csv`: Vueltas (laps) de cada caminata. 1 filas, 2024-02-13 → 2024-02-13.
  Columnas: activityId, activityName, lap_lapIndex, lap_startTimeGMT, lap_distance, lap_duration, lap_movingDuration (s), lap_averageSpeed (m/s), lap_averageHR (bpm), lap_maxHR (bpm), lap_calories, lap_averageRunCadence, lap_maxRunCadence, lap_averageTemperature, lap_maxTemperature, lap_minTemperature, lap_totalAscent, lap_totalDescent
- `correr.csv`: Carreras, una fila por actividad. 1 filas, 2024-02-14 → 2024-02-14.
  Columnas: activityId, activityName, startTimeLocal, distance (m), duration (s), movingDuration (s), calories (kcal), averageHR (bpm), maxHR (bpm), steps, aerobicTrainingEffect, anaerobicTrainingEffect, activityTrainingLoad, trainingEffectLabel, differenceBodyBattery, hrTimeInZone_1 (s), hrTimeInZone_2 (s), hrTimeInZone_3 (s), hrTimeInZone_4 (s), hrTimeInZone_5 (s), moderateIntensityMinutes, vigorousIntensityMinutes, avgElevation, minTemperature, maxTemperature, totalReps, totalSets, activeSets, lapCount, averageSpeed (m/s), activityType
- `correr_laps.csv`: Vueltas (laps) de cada carrera. 5 filas, 2024-02-14 → 2024-02-14.
  Columnas: activityId, activityName, lap_lapIndex, lap_startTimeGMT, lap_distance, lap_duration, lap_movingDuration (s), lap_averageSpeed (m/s), lap_averageHR (bpm), lap_maxHR (bpm), lap_calories, lap_averageRunCadence, lap_maxRunCadence, lap_averageTemperature, lap_maxTemperature, lap_minTemperature, lap_totalAscent, lap_totalDescent
- `daily_steps_aggregated.csv`: Pasos diarios con meta y distancia. 3 filas, 2024-02-17 → 2024-02-19.
  Columnas: calendarDate, totalSteps, totalDistance (m), stepGoal
- `daily_summary.csv`: Resumen diario: pasos, calorías, distancia, FC, estrés, minutos de intensidad, hidratación. 5 filas, 2024-02-17 → 2024-02-21.
  Columnas: date, totalKilocalories (kcal), activeKilocalories (kcal), bmrKilocalories (kcal), totalSteps, totalDistanceMeters (m), wellnessKilocalories (kcal), remainingKilocalories (kcal), floorsAscended, floorsDescended, durationInMilliseconds (ms), stepGoal, maxHeartRate (bpm), minHeartRate (bpm), restingHeartRate (bpm), lastSevenDaysAvgRestingHeartRate (bpm), maxStressLevel, avgStressLevel, moderateIntensityMinutes, vigorousIntensityMinutes, hydrationGoalMl (ml), hydrationValueMl (ml), hydrationSweatLossMl (ml), hydrationActivityIntakeMl (ml)
- `gym.csv`: Fuerza / gimnasio, una fila por actividad. 1 filas, 2024-02-14 → 2024-02-14.
  Columnas: activityId, activityName, startTimeLocal, distance (m), duration (s), movingDuration (s), calories (kcal), averageHR (bpm), maxHR (bpm), steps, aerobicTrainingEffect, anaerobicTrainingEffect, activityTrainingLoad, trainingEffectLabel, differenceBodyBattery, hrTimeInZone_1 (s), hrTimeInZone_2 (s), hrTimeInZone_3 (s), hrTimeInZone_4 (s), hrTimeInZone_5 (s), moderateIntensityMinutes, vigorousIntensityMinutes, avgElevation, minTemperature, maxTemperature, totalReps, totalSets, activeSets, lapCount, averageSpeed (m/s), activityType
- `gym_laps.csv`: Series / vueltas de cada sesión de gimnasio. 1 filas, 2024-02-14 → 2024-02-14.
  Columnas: activityId, activityName, lap_lapIndex, lap_startTimeGMT, lap_distance, lap_duration, lap_movingDuration (s), lap_averageSpeed (m/s), lap_averageHR (bpm), lap_maxHR (bpm), lap_calories, lap_averageRunCadence, lap_maxRunCadence, lap_averageTemperature, lap_maxTemperature, lap_minTemperature, lap_totalAscent, lap_totalDescent
- `hill_score_daily.csv`: Hill score diario. 3 filas, 2024-02-17 → 2024-02-19.
  Columnas: calendarDate, overallScore, strengthScore, enduranceScore, hillScoreClassificationId, hillScoreFeedbackPhraseId
- `hrv.csv`: Variabilidad de la frecuencia cardiaca (HRV) nocturna. 3 filas, 2024-02-17 → 2024-02-19.
  Columnas: date, weeklyAvg, lastNightAvg (ms), lastNight5MinHigh (ms), status, feedbackPhrase, baselineLowUpper (ms), baselineBalancedLow (ms), baselineBalancedUpper (ms)
- `mfp_daily.csv`: MyFitnessPal por día: si hay registro, totales, metas y calorías de ejercicio registradas en MFP. 4 filas, 2026-10-04 → 2026-10-07.
  Columnas: date, logged, meals_logged, foods_logged, energy_kcal (kcal), protein_g (g), carbohydrates_g (g), fat_g (g), fiber_g (g), sugar_g (g), sodium_mg (mg), goal_energy_kcal (kcal), goal_protein_g (g), goal_carbohydrates_g (g), goal_fat_g (g), goal_sodium_mg (mg), goal_sugar_g (g), exercise_kcal_mfp (kcal)
- `mfp_exercise.csv`: Ejercicio registrado en MyFitnessPal; puede repetir ejercicio que Garmin ya tiene. 2 filas, 2026-10-05 → 2026-10-06.
  Columnas: date, name, type, duration_min (min), energy_kcal (kcal), source
- `mfp_food.csv`: Diario de comida de MyFitnessPal, una fila por alimento: comida del día, hora, porción y nutrientes. Calcio, hierro y vitamina D van como los guarda MyFitnessPal para cada alimento, que puede ser porcentaje del valor diario o miligramos.. 4 filas, 2026-10-05 → 2026-10-07.
  Columnas: date, meal, meal_position, consumed_at, logged_at, description, brand, verified, servings, serving_size, serving_unit, grams (g), energy_kcal (kcal), protein_g (g), carbohydrates_g (g), fiber_g (g), sugar_g (g), added_sugars_g (g), fat_g (g), saturated_fat_g (g), trans_fat_g (g), cholesterol_mg (mg), sodium_mg (mg), potassium_mg (mg), calcium, iron, vitamin_d
- `misc_metrics.csv`: Métricas agregadas: edad fitness, predicciones de carrera, umbral de lactato, FTP. 1 filas, 2024-02-19 → 2024-02-19.
  Columnas: race_predictions_userId, race_predictions_fromCalendarDate, race_predictions_toCalendarDate, race_predictions_calendarDate, race_predictions_time5K, race_predictions_time10K, race_predictions_timeHalfMarathon, race_predictions_timeMarathon, lactateThresholdSpeed (m/s), lactateThresholdHeartRate (bpm), cycling_ftp_userProfilePK, cycling_ftp_version, cycling_ftp_calendarDate, cycling_ftp_isStale, cycling_ftp_sequence, cycling_ftp_sport, cycling_ftp_functionalThresholdPower, cycling_ftp_biometricSourceType, fitness_age_chronologicalAge, fitness_age_fitnessAge, fitness_age_achievableFitnessAge, fitness_age_previousFitnessAge, fitness_age_components_vigorousDaysAvg_value, fitness_age_components_vigorousDaysAvg_targetValue, fitness_age_components_vigorousDaysAvg_potentialAge, fitness_age_components_vigorousDaysAvg_priority, fitness_age_components_vigorousDaysAvg_stale, fitness_age_components_vigorousDaysAvg_numOfWeeksForIm, fitness_age_components_rhr_value, fitness_age_components_rhr_stale, fitness_age_components_vigorousMinutesAvg_value, fitness_age_components_vigorousMinutesAvg_targetValue, fitness_age_components_vigorousMinutesAvg_potentialAge, fitness_age_components_vigorousMinutesAvg_priority, fitness_age_components_vigorousMinutesAvg_stale, fitness_age_components_vigorousMinutesAvg_numOfWeeksForIm, fitness_age_components_bmi_value, fitness_age_components_bmi_targetValue, fitness_age_components_bmi_improvementValue, fitness_age_components_bmi_potentialAge, fitness_age_components_bmi_priority, fitness_age_components_bmi_stale, fitness_age_components_bmi_lastMeasurementDate, fitness_age_lastUpdated, hill_score_userProfilePK, hill_score_startDate, hill_score_endDate, hill_score_periodAvgScore_2023-11-24, hill_score_maxScore, hill_score_hillScoreDTOList
- `running_tolerance.csv`: Tolerancia de carrera (carga de impacto). 3 filas, 2024-02-17 → 2024-02-19.
  Columnas: date, acuteImpactLoad, acuteDistance (m), acuteTolerance, runningToleranceFeedBackPhrase
- `sleep.csv`: Sueño, una fila por noche: duración por fase, SpO2, respiración, puntaje. 5 filas, 2024-02-17 → 2024-02-21.
  Columnas: date, sleepTimeSeconds (s), napTimeSeconds (s), unmeasurableSeconds (s), deepSleepSeconds (s), lightSleepSeconds (s), remSleepSeconds (s), awakeSleepSeconds (s), averageSpO2Value (%), lowestSpO2Value (%), highestSpO2Value (%), averageSpO2HRSleep (bpm), averageRespirationValue, lowestRespirationValue, highestRespirationValue, avgSleepStress, sleepScores, sleepResultType, sleepStartTimestampGMT, sleepEndTimestampGMT, sleepStartTimestampLocal, sleepEndTimestampLocal, awakeCount, avgHeartRate (bpm), sleepScoreFeedback, sleepScoreInsight, sleepNeed, nextSleepNeed, breathingDisruptionSeverity, sleepAlignment, sleepWindowConfirmed, restlessMomentsCount, avgOvernightHrv (ms), avgSkinTempDeviationC (°C), restingHeartRate (bpm), bodyBatteryChange
- `spo2_respiration.csv`: Saturación de oxígeno y respiración diarias. 5 filas, 2024-02-17 → 2024-02-21.
  Columnas: date, spo2_avg (%), spo2_lowest (%), respiration_avg, respiration_highest, respiration_lowest
- `training.csv`: Estado y preparación de entrenamiento, carga aguda, VO2 máx. 5 filas, 2024-02-17 → 2024-02-21.
  Columnas: date, readiness_level, readiness_feedbackShort, readiness_feedbackLong, morning_readiness_level, morning_readiness_feedback, morning_readiness_recoveryTime, morning_readiness_sleepScoreFactor, morning_readiness_recoveryTimeFactor, vo2max (ml/kg/min), trainingStatus, trainingLoad_acute, trainingLoad_chronic, trainingLoad_ratio, trainingLoad_ratioStatus, monthlyLoad_aerobicLow, monthlyLoad_aerobicHigh, monthlyLoad_anaerobic, loadBalance_feedback, enduranceScore, enduranceScore_classification
- `weekly_intensity.csv`: Minutos de intensidad por semana. 3 filas, 2024-02-05 → 2024-02-19.
  Columnas: calendarDate, weeklyGoal, moderateValue, vigorousValue

MyFitnessPal: comida registrada en 2 de 4 días. Los días con logged=no no tienen datos, lo que no significa que la persona no comió. Une con los archivos de Garmin por fecha.
